title: Tradable It\^o Signatures: A Model-Free, Interpretable Framework for Dynamic Hedging
abstract: arXiv:2608.18120v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose an interpretable machine-learning framework for dynamic hedging using the It\^o signature transform, which turns asset-price paths into a set of linear features that universally represent nonlinear functions on time-series. We show that each discretized It\^o signature component can be perfectly replicated by a simple self-financing strategy using only the underlying assets and cash, which turns It\^o signature components into tradable and transparent hedging bases. This allows nonlinear derivative payoffs to be approximated by linear combinations of signature terms and hedged through the corresponding combination of trading strategies. We further establish a new approximation result for the It\^o signature and derive theoretical bounds for both in-sample and out-of-sample hedging errors. translated_title: 可交易的伊藤签名：一种无模型、可解释的动态对冲框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18120v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了一种使用伊藤签名变换的可解释机器学习框架，用于动态对冲。该变换将资产价格路径转化为一组线性特征，这些特征能够通用地表示时间序列上的非线性函数。我们表明，每个离散化的伊藤签名分量都可以通过仅使用基础资产和现金的简单自融资策略完美复制，从而使伊藤签名分量成为可交易且透明的对冲基础。这使得非线性衍生品收益可以通过签名项的线性组合来近似，并通过相应的交易策略组合进行对冲。我们进一步建立了伊藤签名的新近似结果，并推导了样本内和样本外对冲误差的理论界限。我们的方法计算高效、易于实现，并避免了未来条件期望的估计，这使其在应用中更具优势。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于伊藤签名的无模型动态对冲框架，通过将签名分量转化为可交易的自融资策略，实现非线性衍生品的透明对冲，并提供理论误差界限，兼具高效性和可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-free dynamic hedging framework based on Itô signatures, converting signature components into tradable self-financing strategies for transparent hedging of nonlinear derivatives, with theoretical error bounds, offering both efficiency and interpretability.
